meta.note: Default cat pet (blue-bicolor Ragdoll placeholder, white-dominant silky straight coat with blue-grey cap/ears/plume tail and a white blaze over the eyes; 96x96, 12 clips / 74 frames from scripts/gen-cat-anim.py + scripts/cat_selkirk.py; artPack v0.2 2026-11-21 idle pass: 8-frame lazy breathing with ear/tail/eye-saccade secondary motion, slow blink at 4 fps = 750ms with a 250ms closed frame). Legacy tags listed in fallback resolve to anim tags.
